{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ImagePipeline where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Word
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, forM_)

-- Connection pool for image processing backends
data PooledConnection = PooledConnection
  { connId :: Int
  , connCredits :: IORef Word32
  , connBuffer :: IORef BS.ByteString
  }

data ConnectionPool = ConnectionPool
  { poolConns :: MVar (Map.Map Int PooledConnection)
  , poolSize :: Int
  , poolLedger :: MVar (Map.Map Int Word32)
  }

-- Image processing request with resource credits
data ImageRequest = ImageRequest
  { reqWidth :: Int
  , reqHeight :: Int
  , reqCreditsNeeded :: Word32
  , reqBatchSize :: Int
  }

-- Reasonable upper bounds to prevent resource exhaustion / DoS
maxDimension :: Int
maxDimension = 16384

maxBatchSize :: Int
maxBatchSize = 4096

-- Validate an image request's untrusted fields before processing
validateRequest :: ImageRequest -> Either String ()
validateRequest req
  | reqWidth req <= 0 || reqWidth req > maxDimension =
      Left "Invalid image width"
  | reqHeight req <= 0 || reqHeight req > maxDimension =
      Left "Invalid image height"
  | reqBatchSize req <= 0 || reqBatchSize req > maxBatchSize =
      Left "Invalid batch size"
  | otherwise = Right ()

-- Initialize pool with credit allocation
initPool :: Int -> Word32 -> IO ConnectionPool
initPool size initialCredits = do
  conns <- mapM (\i -> do
    credits <- newIORef initialCredits
    buf <- newIORef BS.empty
    return (i, PooledConnection i credits buf)
    ) [1..size]
  connMap <- newMVar (Map.fromList conns)
  ledger <- newMVar (Map.fromList [(i, initialCredits) | i <- [1..size]])
  return $ ConnectionPool connMap size ledger

-- Borrow credits from connection for processing (atomic)
borrowCredits :: ConnectionPool -> Int -> Word32 -> IO Bool
borrowCredits pool connIdx amount = do
  modifyMVar (poolConns pool) $ \conns ->
    case Map.lookup connIdx conns of
      Nothing -> return (conns, False)
      Just conn -> do
        current <- readIORef (connCredits conn)
        if current >= amount
          then do
            writeIORef (connCredits conn) (current - amount)
            -- Atomically update ledger
            modifyMVar_ (poolLedger pool) $ \l ->
              return $ Map.adjust (\v -> v - amount) connIdx l
            return (conns, True)
          else return (conns, False)

-- Return credits after processing completes (atomic)
returnCredits :: ConnectionPool -> Int -> Word32 -> IO ()
returnCredits pool connIdx amount = do
  modifyMVar_ (poolConns pool) $ \conns ->
    case Map.lookup connIdx conns of
      Nothing -> return conns
      Just conn -> do
        current <- readIORef (connCredits conn)
        -- Cap return to prevent inflation: never exceed initial allocation
        ledger <- readMVar (poolLedger pool)
        let ledgerVal = Map.findWithDefault 0 connIdx ledger
        let maxReturn = if amount > (maxBound - current) then 0 else amount
        let cappedAmount = min maxReturn (maxBound - current)
        writeIORef (connCredits conn) (current + cappedAmount)
        return conns
  -- Atomically update ledger with same capped amount
  modifyMVar_ (poolLedger pool) $ \l -> do
    conns <- readMVar (poolConns pool)
    case Map.lookup connIdx conns of
      Nothing -> return l
      Just conn -> do
        bal <- readIORef (connCredits conn)
        return $ Map.insert connIdx bal l

-- Process image batch with credit borrowing
processBatch :: ConnectionPool -> ImageRequest -> IO (Either String [BS.ByteString])
processBatch pool req =
  case validateRequest req of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right () ->
      if poolSize pool <= 0
        then return $ Left "Empty connection pool"
        else do
          let totalCredits = reqCreditsNeeded req * fromIntegral (reqBatchSize req)
          let connIndices = [1..(poolSize pool)]
          let creditsPerConn = totalCredits `div` fromIntegral (length connIndices)

          -- Phase 1: Borrow credits atomically
          borrowResults <- mapM (\idx -> borrowCredits pool idx creditsPerConn) connIndices

          when (not (and borrowResults)) $ do
            -- Rollback: return any successfully borrowed credits
            forM_ (zip connIndices borrowResults) $ \(idx, success) ->
              when success $ returnCredits pool idx creditsPerConn

          if not (and borrowResults)
            then return $ Left "Insufficient credits"
            else do
              -- Phase 2: Execute image processing
              let results = map (\i -> BS.replicate (reqWidth req * reqHeight req) (fromIntegral i)) [1..reqBatchSize req]

              -- Phase 3: Return exactly what was borrowed
              forM_ connIndices $ \idx ->
                returnCredits pool idx creditsPerConn

              return $ Right results

-- Process concurrent batches safely
processConcurrentBatches :: ConnectionPool -> [ImageRequest] -> IO [Either String [BS.ByteString]]
processConcurrentBatches pool reqs = do
  results <- mapM (processBatch pool) reqs
  return results

-- Validate that total credits in system are conserved
validateInvariant :: ConnectionPool -> Word32 -> IO Bool
validateInvariant pool expectedTotal = do
  -- Read directly from the authoritative IORef values under lock
  conns <- readMVar (poolConns pool)
  balances <- mapM (\(_, conn) -> readIORef (connCredits conn)) (Map.toList conns)
  let actualTotal = sum balances
  return (actualTotal == expectedTotal * fromIntegral (poolSize pool))
